win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: PYRO REEL
wilds.behavior:
When the Pyro symbol lands it expands into a full Pyro wild reel if it participates in any winning combinations.

 Only 1 Pyro symbol can land per reel.

 Pyro symbols are not available in the BLAZE OF GLORY bonus game.

 All Pyro reel positions count as WILD symbols and substitute for all paying symbols.

wilds.name: BLAZE OF GLORY
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the BLAZE OF GLORY bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FULL MOON BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 The Global multiplier starts at x1 and is persistent throughout the whole bonus, increasing by +1 at the start of every spin.

 Pyro symbols are not available in this bonus.

 Wild symbols become sticky for the entire duration of the bonus game!

 Landing more FULL MOON BONUS scatter symbols at the same time during the bonus game grants additional free spins as follows:

 1 FULL MOON BONUS scatter symbol - 1 extra spin.

 2 FULL MOON BONUS scatter symbols - 3 extra spins.

 3 FULL MOON BONUS scatter symbols - 10 extra spins.

 FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbols are not available during this bonus game.

wilds.name: FLAME FOX'S FRENZY
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the FLAME FOX'S FRENZY bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 This bonus mode follows the base game mechanics with an increased chance of landing Wild and Pyro symbols.

 The Global multiplier starts at x1 and is persistent throughout the whole bonus, increasing by +1 at the start of every spin.

 Landing more FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbols at the same time during the bonus game grants additional free spins as follows:

 1 FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbol - 1 extra spin.

 2 FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbols - 3 extra spins.

 3 FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbols - 10 extra spins.

 FULL MOON BONUS scatter symbols are not available during this bonus game.

wilds.name: WILD SYMBOL
wilds.behavior: The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: BONUS SCATTER SYMBOLS
scatters.behavior:
You can land maximum 3 FULL MOON BONUS or FIRE TREE BONUS scatter symbols in the same spin.

 Only one type of scatter symbols can be present on the board at the same time.

multipliers.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER
multipliers.behavior:
The global multiplier is displayed above the reels and multiplies all wins. It is not available in the base game.

 In the bonus games the multiplier starts at x1 and it increases by +1 at the start of every spin.

collectors.name: FIERY WHEEL OF FORTUNE
collectors.behavior:
When BLAZE OF GLORY Bonus or FLAME FOX'S FRENZY Bonus are triggered, the player will have the chance to gamble for a chance to win additional free spins.

 The player can gamble up to 3 times or collect the currently awarded free spins at any time before a gamble.

 Each gambling round results in the following amount of free spins based on the outcome:

 {imgTag}

 First gamble:

 Collect: 10 free spins

 Gamble Win: 15 free spins

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

 Second gamble:

 Collect: 15 free spins

 Gamble Win: 20 free spins

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

 Third gamble:

 Collect: 20 free spins

 Gamble Win: 25 free spins

 Gamble Loss: 10 free spins

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS
